// Room "P3 dining room" (interior designer's part): inner air x58..60, y2..4, z14..17 (plan.md FLOORS, rooms.json).
// Layout: the dining table is the focal piece, on the middle column x59 with a chair at each end (north and south).
// The east column x60 holds a barrel dresser at z14..15 and stays clear at z16..17, and the west column x58 is the
// lane from the cased opening (x57) and round to the kitchen door (59,18), so every cell stays reachable.
// Light: one lantern hangs over the table (the focal piece sits in the brightest light), one over the west lane.
import { layers } from "/Volumes/ext1/swe/repos/minecraft-design/tools/src/build.mjs";

export function build(g) {
  // legend: one character per block; '.' is left as it is (free floor)
  const legend = {
    c: ["oak_stairs", { facing: "north", half: "bottom" }], // chair north of the table, back to the north wall
    s: ["oak_stairs", { facing: "south", half: "bottom" }], // chair south of the table, back to the south
    f: "oak_fence", // table leg (the post)
    t: ["oak_slab", { type: "top" }], // table top, sits on the post at y3
    k: "barrel", // dresser on the east wall
    p: "potted_poppy", // on the dresser's top face
    L: ["lantern", { hanging: "true" }], // hangs from the upper floor's block at y5
  };
  layers(g, [58, 2, 14], legend, [
    // y2: floor layer of the furniture (rows z14..17, columns x58..60)
    [".ck", ".fk", ".s.", "..."],
    // y3: table top and the pot on the dresser
    ["..p", ".t.", "...", "..."],
    // y4: lanterns (rows z14..17)
    ["...", ".L.", "L..", "..."],
  ]);
}

input.summary:
Stuck: room-24 (P3 dining room) places 0 of 9 blocks. Every cell of its footprint (x58..60, y2..4, z14..16) is already owned as air by shell west (house() fills the ground interior with air), so runParts refuses all writes; nothing in the room can move without changing shell-west.
No off-palette blocks, so OFF-PALETTE is clear; the REFUSED line remains (9 writes).
room-24.mjs left as designed (table, chairs, barrel dresser, potted poppy, lantern). make.sh runs whole, but the dining room is empty.

waste.what: Working out which earlier part owned each refused cell: I read runParts' lock rule in build.mjs and then the shell-west house() source by hand to find the air fill.
waste.cost: ~6 tool calls reading source, plus one manual per-part cell dump
waste.tool: A report line from runParts that names the owning part and whether the owner wrote air (e.g. 'owned by shell west (plots 0-3) as air: 9 of 9 footprint cells'). The per-part dump is currently MCD_PARTS_CELLS=<file>, which is undocumented and raw JSON.

waste.what: Checking whether the footprint could be partly writable by listing the unowned cells in the room box.
waste.cost: One extra build run with MCD_PARTS_CELLS and a Python filter over the dump
waste.tool: `mcd parts build.nbt --box x0,y0,z0,x1,y1,z1` (or a plan.md-style footprint check) listing which cells of a room box each earlier part owns, so the room designer sees writable cells before writing a layout.

waste.what: The refusal report prints only the first 8 of 9 refused writes (refusedAt.slice(0,8)), so the ninth (58,4,16 lantern) was never shown.
waste.cost: Had to infer the ninth write from the layers grid
waste.tool: Print all refused writes (or a count plus the full list in parts-report.json), not a slice of 8.

left: BLOCKED, upstream: shell-west (parts/shell-west.mjs, house() line 16: g.fill([x0+1,2,z0+1],[x1-1,top,z1-1],"air")) writes explicit air over the whole ground interior of P0-P3, so every ground-floor cell in room-24's footprint is locked. The fix belongs in shell-west, not here: fill body only on the walls and floor, leaving the interior unset, so later parts can place into it. Other P3 ground rooms (hall, living, kitchen) are probably blocked the same way, and P0-P2 ground rooms likely are too (not verified).

Not done, your call: clearing the REFUSED line now would mean deleting all 9 writes (the table, chairs, dresser, pot and lantern). That leaves a dark, empty dining room that would also fail the light and walk checks. I did not do it; say so and I will strip the layout.
make.sh runs to a whole build.nbt, but the P3 dining room has no furniture in it. The part is not built.
